698.description_text: Magnesium citrate is a type of magnesium supplement. It is often used to help with bowel movements and ensure the body has enough magnesium to function properly. Relieving Constipation: Magnesium citrate works as a mild laxative, helping to move stool through the intestines more easily. It draws water into the bowels, which softens the stool and makes it easier to pass. Magnesium citrate is gentler than some of the other magnesium compounds and is found as the active ingredient in many commercially available laxatives. Supplementing Magnesium Levels: Magnesium is an important mineral that our bodies need for many functions, like maintaining healthy muscles and nerves, supporting a steady heartbeat, and helping bones stay strong. Some people take a magnesium citrate supplement to help boost their magnesium levels, especially if they are low on this mineral or don’t get enough in their diet. Additional Magnesium Citrate Benefits In addition to relieving constipation and supplementing magnesium levels, taking a magnesium citrate supplement can offer the following health benefits: Support Muscle and Nerve Function: Magnesium is essential for proper muscle contractions and nerve signaling, helping prevent cramps and spasms. Promote Heart Health: Magnesium helps maintain a regular heartbeat and supports overall cardiovascular health by regulating blood pressure. Aid in Bone Health: Magnesium, working alongside calcium, plays a key role in bone formation and maintaining bone density. Magnesium Citrate Supplements Country Life Vitamins’ Magnesium Citrate 250mg tablets can help relax muscles and support bone health while also supplementing any dietary gaps in magnesium. Shop our selection of daily health supplements online to find other vitamins and supplements to enhance your overall wellness.
